title: Refactor a bit page mapping stuff in order to be able to support delete/copy pages

target.summary: Using the PagesMapper.instance singleton causes page mapping state to be shared across all documents. When multiple documents are opened concurrently, their page counts and page mappings overwrite each other, causing getPage calls to reject with an 'Invalid page request' error or return wrong pages.
notes: definition of the PagesMapper singleton instance getter
